P_0x003362: A Kouryu Squadron ATX pilot. Gentle and quiet, but shows real resolve when it matters. Loves health gadgets and baths. A telekinetic who pilots a <T-LINK System> unit. Involved with "Bullet".
P_0x0034D0: A Kouryu Squadron SRX pilot. Hot-blooded, impulsive, a huge robot fan. Somewhat childish, yet mentally one of the strongest. Also telekinetic. Rank: 2nd Lieutenant.
P_0x0035F1: A Kouryu Squadron SRX pilot from the Branstein family, a noted military line. Calm and skilled. A bit sarcastic, but shows a loyal, hot-blooded side too. Rank: 2nd Lieutenant.
P_0x00372C: SRX Team pilot and squad leader. A telekinetic; before enlisting she was a test subject in her father's research. Later joined the <SRX Project> and helped develop the <T-LINK System>.\nResponsible and caring. Seems headstrong, but is truly kind and dislikes fighting. Rank: Captain.
P_0x003971: A Kouryu Squadron SRX pilot. Aya Kobayashi's sister, once listed dead in an accident. Quiet, but has no memory of her past.\nFound after the <L5 Campaign>, she recovered under father Kenzo Kobayashi before joining SRX as a trainee.
P_0x003B28: Captain of the Kouryu Squadron SRX Team. Once a double agent in the <Aerogaters>. Intelligent, composed; seems cold, but simply hides emotion. An infiltration expert, also in the <SRX Project>. Age unknown; rank: Captain.
